DHAKA, Nov 15, 2022 (BSS) - Air Incheon, a South Korean cargo airline, has started direct Seoul-Dhaka-Seoul cargo flight that will guarantee a single-day arrival for any urgent goods in between Bangladesh and the east Asian nation.

TAD Logistics, a local international freight forwarder launched the two weekly direct cargo flight on Saturday, a press release said here today.
